description: Call this only once the fix is done AND published (or the setting saved): it re-runs exactly the problems get_check_result reported, on the live app. This is the way to re-check an app that was already checked: never start a new check_live_app for it. A fix made in a setting (for example the backend's auth settings), with nothing new to publish, counts too: if this answers that nothing new is published, call it once more and it re-checks. Then call get_check_result with the same check_id to see each problem marked fixed or not. Do not tell the person a problem is fixed until this says so. After each re-check, tell the person how many re-checks are left (this tool's answer says).

problem_ids.description: Optional: only these problem ids. Default: every problem it found.

name: confirm_fix
title: Confirm the fix on the live app
